claims.quote: Treatment of trichomoniasis in patients 12 years of age and older.

claims.text: Single 2 g packet of granules PO, w or w.o food
claims.quote: The recommended dosage of SOLOSEC for the treatment of trichomoniasis in patients 12 years of age and older is a single 2-gram packet of granules taken once orally, without regard to the timing of meals [see Clinical Pharmacology (12.3)].
